contracts: (A fresh verifier process reports the topology artifact as current, integrity-valid, executed, and semantically proving no placement authority; invalid or stale artifacts fail.) AND (终端命令成功发现并执行所有必需类别，结果可由独立验证器逐类确认。) AND (验证器在独立进程中完成并输出非声明式、可判定结果)
selector_intents: OperationsBoundaryTests.TopologySeedEvidence_IsIndependentlyVerifiable invokes the new-process evidence verifier over current topology results and checks integrity, freshness, execution status, ownership, and restore-validity fields.
运行新进程证据验证器并提供缺失、过期、篡改或未执行的证据包，验证器必须拒绝该输入
运行终端全套验证并分别选择 OS 隔离、重启/故障、Snapshot-Restore 路由、旧数据迁移和 A18 证据案例，任一必需类别缺失、跳过或不可独立复核即失败。
